name: EU DORA & NIS2 Digital Operational Resilience Compliance
description: Compliance framework for the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA - Regulation (EU) 2022/2554), NIS2 Directive ((EU) 2022/2555), and Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), covering ICT risk management, threat-led penetration testing (TLPT), major incident reporting, and third-party risk.

checklists.name: EU DORA & NIS2 Control Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for DORA Articles 5-30 and NIS2 security management obligations.

items.statement: ICT Risk Management Framework is reviewed annually and approved by the Management Body (DORA Art. 6).
Major ICT incidents trigger initial notification within 4h (classification) / 24h to competent authorities (DORA Art. 19).
Threat-Led Penetration Testing (TLPT) covering production systems is executed at least every 3 years (DORA Art. 26).
Register of Information is maintained detailing all contractual arrangements with ICT third-party service providers (DORA Art. 28).
Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) is published in machine-readable format for all software products.

reviewGates.name: EU DORA & NIS2 Resilience Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The CISO and Head of Risk confirm that ICT risk management, TLPT testing, and third-party contracts comply with DORA & NIS2.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the operational resilience evidence confirm full compliance with EU DORA and NIS2 regulations?
